fact: The National General Education Progress Report 2024 reports education statistics (enrolment, repetition, drop-outs, completion for 2022-2024, Annual Education Census 2024) compiled from administrative data collected from all schools on the DHIS2-based EMIS, with examination administrative data from the Examinations Council of Eswatini.
title: The National General Education Progress Report 2024
publisher: Ministry of Education and Training, Kingdom of Eswatini
